parameters.content:
## 15 Content To Lead Tracker

Ties each published post, video or repo to the leads and pipeline it actually produced.

**Safety rails:** Does not call the rails. Read-only reporting over your own database, with one Slack post to your own channel.

**Before you enable this:** replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, point CRM_BASE_URL/CRM_ADAPTER at your CRM, and run it once manually with test data.

Docs: README.md, docs/SETUP.md, docs/COMPLIANCE.md

parameters.query:
SELECT id, slug, title, platform, url, published_at
FROM content_registry
WHERE published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days'
ORDER BY published_at DESC;

nodes.name: Load Content Registry
nodes.notes: You maintain this table. One row per post, video or repo you publish.

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO content_performance (slug, period_end, leads, hot_leads, pipeline_usd, computed_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.slug }}', CURRENT_DATE, {{ $json.leads }}, {{ $json.hot_leads }},
        {{ $json.pipeline_usd }}, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (slug, period_end) DO UPDATE
SET leads = EXCLUDED.leads, hot_leads = EXCLUDED.hot_leads,
    pipeline_usd = EXCLUDED.pipeline_usd, computed_at = NOW();

parameters.text: =Content to pipeline (180d): {{ $json.slug }} - {{ $json.leads }} leads, {{ $json.hot_leads }} hot, {{ $json.pipeline_usd }} USD. Unattributed leads in period: {{ $json.unattributed_leads }}
